title: 2011 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 7
statement: Let \(n\) be an even positive integer. Prove that \(\varphi(n) \leq \frac{n}{2}\).

solutions.text: Again, let \(A_{n}\) be the set of all positive integers \(x \leq n\) such that \(\operatorname{gcd}(n, x)=1\). Since \(n\) is even, no element of \(A_{n}\) may be even, and, by definition, every element of \(A_{n}\) must be at most \(n\). It follows that \(\varphi(n)\), the number of elements of \(A_{n}\), must be at most \(\frac{n}{2}\), as desired.
